headline: Fisherman's Row Quickens as Cradle, Expanse Churn
war_summary: Since the three o'clock edition the wire has shifted to Fisherman's Row, which counts five changes in two hours and forty-six on the day about Eidolo, Black Well, Arcadia, Fort Ember and Oceanwatch to the filing minute, now standing two Warden, six Colonial and one destroyed. Weathered Expanse remains heavy with six changes in two hours and forty-two on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, latest at twenty to six, now five Warden to four Colonial with day losses near thirteen thousand Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden. Stonecradle has quickened to five changes in two hours and twelve on the day about World's End, the Cord and Trammel Pool, also latest at twenty to six, holding five Warden to four Colonial. Mooring County adds three changes in two hours and Linn Mercy two, last heard near five o'clock, while Stlican Shelf, with thirty-five on the day, and Farranac Coast record no change in two hours, last turning after two and four o'clock. Callahan's Passage shows heavy day losses without a fresh flip.
